public_rationale: The post's stated inputs give $48B − ($12.4B + $15.5B) = $20.1B, rather than $19.1B; this checks its arithmetic, not the underlying figures [e1]. Anthropic's May 28, 2026 announcement says its annualized run rate crossed $47B earlier that month, without giving an exact May value [e2]. Its October 26 filing reports $16.3B in revenue for January–June 2026, compared with the post's $15.5B [e1, e3]. These records do not establish the exact difference between the May annualized run rate and the companies' combined realized H1 revenue [e1–e3].
limitations: The packet does not independently establish OpenAI's $12.4B H1 revenue figure [e1].
The May announcement supplies a threshold, not an exact run-rate observation [e2].
Anthropic's unaudited H1 filing figure is not reconciled with the post's press estimate [e1, e3].

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Combined H1 2026 revenue of Anthropic and OpenAI was $19.1 billion short of Anthropic's May 2026 $48 billion run rate.

statement.excerpt: In fact, if you added up every dollar that both Anthropic and OpenAI made in the first two quarters, you’d be $19.1 billion short of Anthropic’s May “run rate.”

from_speaker: every dollar that both Anthropic and OpenAI made
our_interpretation: ‘Made’ means revenue, not profit, as established by the preceding paragraph.
The comparison subtracts combined realized H1 2026 revenue from Anthropic's announced May annualized run rate.
The stated gap is assessed to one decimal place in billions of US dollars.
The comparison deliberately involves two different measures. Its arithmetic can be checked, but neither measure is substituted for the other.
The single metric_scope describes the composite comparison; its component evidence retains separate scopes.
criteria.support_condition: Independently established inputs on the stated reporting bases produce a difference rounding to $19.1 billion.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Independently established comparable inputs produce a different rounded difference, or an authoritative reconciliation directly disproves the stated difference.
